content.headline: Why DeclarativeWeb?
content.subhead: Stop writing boilerplate. Start describing what you want.

content.content:
## The Problem with Traditional Web Development

Building websites traditionally means juggling **HTML**, **CSS**, **JavaScript**, build tools, bundlers, transpilers, and a dozen config files. Want to add a button? Write HTML, add event listeners, manage state, update the DOM manually.

**It's exhausting.** And it's even worse for AI assistants trying to help you.

content.title: 🎯 Declarative vs Imperative
content.subtitle: Tell the computer WHAT you want, not HOW to do it

## 🤖 Built for the AI Era

LLMs are great at generating structured data. They're terrible at writing bug-free JavaScript with proper DOM manipulation, event handling, and state management.

**DeclarativeWeb plays to AI's strengths:**

resources.title: JSON is Native
resources.description: LLMs think in structured data. JSON is their natural language. No syntax errors, no missing semicolons.

resources.title: Predictable Output
resources.description: Same input = same output. No runtime surprises. Easy to validate, easy to fix.

resources.title: Self-Documenting
resources.description: The JSON IS the documentation. No hunting through files to understand what's happening.

content.content:
### Real Talk: Ask an LLM to Build You a Website

| What You Ask | Traditional Output | DeclarativeWeb Output |
|--------------|-------------------|------------------|
| "Add a hero section" | 50+ lines of HTML/CSS | 5 lines of JSON |
| "Make it interactive" | Buggy JS, missing handlers | Add `action` property |
| "Change the layout" | Rewrite CSS, break things | Change `columns: 3` |
| "Add a data table" | Manual DOM creation | `type: "table"`, done |
| "Fetch from API" | Callback hell, error handling | One function, auto-updates |

⏱️ Hours to first deploy
😎 With DeclarativeWeb

  • Write site.json

  • Done.

content.content:
### The Honest Truth

DeclarativeWeb isn't trying to replace React for building the next Facebook. It's for:

- ✅ **Landing pages** that need to ship yesterday
- ✅ **Prototypes** that prove concepts fast
- ✅ **Documentation sites** that just work
- ✅ **AI-generated content** that doesn't break
- ✅ **Simple apps** that don't need 200 dependencies
- ✅ **Developers** who are tired of JavaScript fatigue
